_meta.description: Single source of truth for brand identity. Name, tagline and colours live here. The cow mark's geometry lives in scripts/build-brand-svgs.mjs; `npm run brand:build` writes every SVG variant to /public and `npm run brand:png` renders the PNG/ICO icons and the social card.

name: CultureFlow
shortTag: Events for the South Sudanese community
description: Discover and host events for South Sudanese — at home and across the diaspora. Tickets, discovery, and connection in one place for our tribes, clans, churches, and communities.
_markNote: Mark = a Nilotic long-horned cow: open lyre horns in flag blue, black head, the flag's gold star cradled between the horn tips. Name = CULTURE / FLOW in wide Archivo Black caps; FLOW takes the horn colour. Flat colour, sharp edges, no gradients. See docs/brand.md.
